string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_execution_summary
string.translation: Use input for selected text. Return a string to commit it. Each tap starts a fresh QuickJS runtime.

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_execution_dialog_message
string.translation:
Use input to read the current selection. If nothing is selected, input is an empty string.

Return a string to commit it to the editor. Returning null, undefined, or nothing finishes without commit.

Global JavaScript runs before the slot body on every key press.

The slot body and Global JavaScript share the same execution, but every tap creates a fresh QuickJS runtime and context. Do not rely on state from an earlier run.

If Global JavaScript needs input, define a helper there and pass input into it from the slot body.

This environment is synchronous-only. DOM, Node.js APIs, fetch, and async request pipelines are not available.

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_return_summary
string.translation: Only non-null return values commit text, and commit is skipped if InputConnection changed during execution.

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_return_dialog_message
string.translation:
Return contract:
- return a non-null and non-undefined value to commit it as text
- return null, return undefined, or omit return to finish without commit

Even after a successful run, text only commits when the InputConnection at the end is still the same object captured at the start. Focus changes or editor switches fail closed.

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_http_summary
string.translation: Beyond standard QuickJS features, this patch also provides input, httpRequest(options), httpGet(url), and httpPost(url, body).

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_http_dialog_message
string.translation:
Beyond standard QuickJS features, this patch provides these extra host APIs:
- input
- httpRequest(options)
- httpGet(url)
- httpPost(url, body)

httpRequest only accepts GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE. Only http:// and https:// URLs are allowed. headers must be a plain object, and body is sent as UTF-8.

Non-2xx status, invalid method, invalid URL scheme, timeout, invalid headers, transport errors, and response bodies over the configured limit all throw script errors.

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_limits_summary
string.translation: Slots are clamped by global timeout, response, memory, and stack limits; syntax and runtime errors fail only that run.

string.name: gboard_patches_top_row_js_guide_limits_dialog_message
string.translation:
Runtime limits:
- slot timeoutMs input must stay within 0..global timeoutMaxMs; after sanitize the runtime minimum is 1 ms
- response body limit, memory limit, and max stack come from JavaScript Runtime Limits

Defaults:
- timeoutMaxMs: 30000 ms
- response body: 1 MiB
- memory: 8 MiB
- max stack: 512 KiB

Syntax errors, runtime errors, timeouts, HTTP failures, oversized responses, and InputConnection changes fail closed for the current run only. They do not disable the whole Custom Top Row feature.

string.name: language_models_dictionary_languages_help

string.name: language_models_results_count
string.translation: Delight dictionaries: %1$d language and variant entries

string.name: language_models_hmm_about_title
string.translation: HMM · Chinese and Korean dictionaries and conversion

string.name: language_models_hmm_about
string.translation: Dictionary and model resources for Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean and related input methods. Switching may affect word conversion, candidate ranking and continuation predictions for input such as Zhuyin and Pinyin.

string.name: language_models_delight_about
string.translation: Dictionaries and language models for English, German, Thai and many other languages. Switching may affect suggested vocabulary, spelling correction, candidate ranking and next-word suggestions. The selector chooses the overall dictionary catalog; each language and variant has its own dictionary version and may update at a different time.

string.name: language_models_nwp_about
string.translation: Next-word prediction: an additional American English engine that suggests following words from the text already entered. It does not replace the main dictionary; disabling it does not disable every source of next-word suggestions.

string.name: language_models_key_correction_about
string.translation: A Google American English TFLite model used for input-correction triggering, separate from the main dictionary. Presets apply the matching TFLite enable and key-routing flags together.

string.name: language_models_saft_about
string.translation: Auxiliary models and biasing dictionaries retrieved by the Gboard user-feature-cache manager. This catalog provides American English, German, Spanish and French resources, rather than the main Traditional Chinese model. This selects resource configuration; Gboard controls usage conditions. Native SAFT version detection is not yet available.

string.name: language_models_mozc_spell_about
string.translation: Separate data for Japanese spelling-correction suggestions. It is independent of the main kana-to-kanji dictionary. Selecting resources does not enable system spell checking.

string.name: language_models_mozc_about
string.translation: Main dictionary and language data for Japanese input. Switching may affect vocabulary for kana-to-kanji conversion, conversion candidates and their ranking.

string.name: language_models_grammar_about
string.translation: Grammar correction resources for supported languages such as English, Spanish, French and Portuguese. These affect sentence error detection and correction suggestions. Selecting resources here does not enable the Grammar Checker feature.

string.name: language_models_langid_about
string.translation: Identifies the likely language of multilingual input to help select suggestions from the appropriate language. It is not a dictionary and does not add input languages; switching may affect language decisions for multilingual suggestions.

string.name: language_models_restart_help
string.translation: Restart Gboard, open the relevant language keyboard, then check again.

string.name: language_models_submitted
string.translation: Submitted to NWP engine; readiness is not yet confirmed

string.translation: Language name or locale, for example English, German, Thai, en-US

string.name: language_models_detection_scope_help
string.translation: Native load observation is available for HMM, Delight, NWP and key correction. Key-correction resource versions are identified by reviewed file SHA-256 values. Mozc main/spellchecker, Grammar, Lang-id and SAFT currently provide configuration selection without native version detection.
